notInOperationalCatalogue.brev: GPU development and validation environment - represented under deployments/validation, not as an operational data source
notInOperationalCatalogue.supabase_platform: internal application dependency - represented under Platform Administration, not customer Connections
notInOperationalCatalogue.kubernetes: runtime/deployment substrate - represented under Platform Administration unless a future customer-owned cluster is explicitly bound
notInOperationalCatalogue.search_analytics: web-presence analytics - not an AURA DC operational connector
notInOperationalCatalogue.workspace_documents: build-time/knowledge source - not facility telemetry or operational exchange
notInOperationalCatalogue.asset_manifest: asset-pipeline capability - owned by Blueprint/asset validation

rules: Add connection is offered only when runtime_adapter is non-null and implementation_status is IMPLEMENTED
Planned connectors expose View requirements only
Generic REST is never labelled ServiceNow integration
No connector is named DSX Exchange unless it implements the official event-bus contracts
Existing AURA managed OpenUSD storage is not evidence that DDN Infinia is deployed
Redfish and NVIDIA DCGM remain planned until an AURA-owned runtime adapter and operational source are verified
